notes.text: Relative offsets, absolute containing blocks, fixed viewport positioning, fixed descendants in scrolled ancestors, physical-inset sticky positioning, sticky table headers, containing-block limits, physical and logical opposing/end insets, CSS-wide static resets, and z-index ordering have parity fixtures.

Fixed positioning is represented through Taffy absolute positioning in the viewport-rooted layout tree. Taffy does not implement sticky positioning, so sticky boxes remain in Taffy normal flow and are constrained against their supported scrollport during geometry collection.
